_comment: Charlotte housing-news feeds for MonitorCLT. Verified 2026-08-25 from a datacenter IP. 'native' feeds are the outlet's own RSS; 'proxy' feeds route via Google News because the outlet sits behind Cloudflare and blocks server-side fetches. Re-run verify_feeds.py before trusting any of these after a site redesign. Proxy queries are windowed with when:14d.

feeds.note: Root https://www.wfae.org/index.rss parses but is EMPTY (0 items) - do not use it. Section feeds carry the items.
Business/development coverage. Pairs with wfae_news; expect overlap, dedupe on link.
Full site feed, ~20 items. Note the path is /rss.xml - /feed/ and /rss both 404.

Direct McClatchy feeds reset the connection from a server IP (curl err 92). Google News site: filter returns genuine Observer headlines. Query is windowed to when:14d - without it Google returns years-old articles.
axios.com/local/charlotte/feed and api.axios.com/feed/* both return Cloudflare 403 to servers. Query is windowed to when:14d - without it Google returns years-old articles.

feeds.bizjournals.com/bizj_charlotte returns S3 AccessDenied; bizjournals.com/charlotte/news/rss.xml returns Cloudflare 403. CBJ is paywalled, so headlines are the usable signal anyway. Query is windowed to when:14d - without it Google returns years-old articles.

Publishes at thecharlotteledger.com (Substack custom domain). RSS is off: /feed, /feed/, /rss.xml and /feed.xml all 404 on the custom domain, and charlotteledger.substack.com/feed returns 403 to curl UAs and 404 to browser UAs. Newsletter-first, so Google indexes it thinly - only ~6 items. Most reliable capture is subscribing hello@cltbuys.com to the newsletter and parsing inbound mail. Query is windowed to when:14d - without it Google returns years-old articles.
Catch-all. This is the feed to pitch off of - it shows what is running in the cycle right now, across every outlet, including ones not listed here.
